author: Good Enough
description:
A mudslide can happen suddenly, sending fast-moving mud, rocks, and debris downhill with enough force to sweep away people, vehicles, and buildings. Knowing where to move, what areas to avoid, and how to react if you’re caught in one can greatly improve your chances of survival.

This Short explains how to survive a mudslide, what to do during a debris flow, how to escape moving mud and debris, and the biggest mistakes to avoid during a landslide emergency.
title: How to Survive a Mudslide 🌧️🏔️ #naturaldisaster #survival #survivaltips #outdoors

author: Good Enough
description:
A tsunami can become deadly within minutes, sending massive walls of water inland with enough force to destroy buildings, sweep away vehicles, and trap anyone who waits too long to move. Knowing when to evacuate, where to go, and what to do if the water starts rising can greatly improve your chances of survival.

This Short explains how to survive a tsunami, what to do after a tsunami warning, how to reach higher ground, and the biggest mistakes to avoid during one of the most dangerous natural disasters on Earth.
title: How to Survive a Deadly Tsunami 🌊⚠️ #tsunami #naturaldisaster #survival #survivaltips
